text:
maria (PM): Hey team — attaching updated PRD + decision matrix for ChatFlow API (completions + embeddings + rerank). Link: https://redwood.internal/prd/chatflow-decision-matrix

kevin (Eng): :eyes: skimmed. Main perf risk = rerank at high qps. Need a sampled path for rerank to keep p95 latency sane.

jana (ML): Note on quality: pre-filtering candidates before rerank biases results. Post-filter rerank keeps diversity but costs more. We should measure precision@1 and precision@3 across prompt families.

owen (Design): UX flag: streaming partial responses + midstream rerank feels broken. Either disable streaming when rerank is active or stream only server-decided deltas after rerank.

lucy (SRE): Operational constraints: 1024-dim embeddings spike memory usage on our current pool. Ops prefers 512 quantized as default. Propose dynamic routing: 512 for standard, 1024 for enterprise tier.

kevin (Eng): Implementation sketch for API contract:
```json
POST /v1/chatflow/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-chatflow-v1",
  "embedding_variant": "512-q",
  "rerank_mode": "post-filter", // options: off | pre-filter | post-filter | sampled
  "stream": false
}
```
Default = 512-q + post-filter sampled.

sam (ProductOps): Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
1) P95 end-to-end latency <= 600ms on default config at baseline qps.
2) Precision@1 >= baseline + 2% for rerank ON.
3) Streaming disabled when rerank_mode != off OR streaming=false is explicit.
4) Fallback behaviour: if rerank fails, respond with original completion + metric tag rerank.failure=true.

maria (PM): My decision matrix suggestion: rows = customer_tier (self-serve/growth/enterprise), columns = latency SLO / cost multiplier / allowed embedding_dim. Proposal: self-serve = default 512-q post-filter sampled 20%; growth = opt-in 1024 for important routes; enterprise = configurable, SLA negotiation. Lock scope by EOD Friday.

jana (ML): Eval plan: run 10k prompt across 6 domains (support, search, summarization, sales, legal, finances). Measure p95 latency, precision@1/3, and hallucination delta. I'll own harness + datasets.

owen (Design): Console changes: new toggle group for "Rerank" with 3 options + tooltip, and a cost preview showing estimated token + rerank cost delta. Mockups linked in PRD.

kevin (Eng): Fallback and rollout plan:
- Default rollout: feature flag off for 24h smoke, then 5% traffic for 48h (sampled rerank), then 25%, then 100%.
- If rerank.latency_p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 1% during rollout, auto-rollback.

lucy (SRE): Monitoring hooks to add before rollout: trace tag `rerank.variant`, metric `rerank.latency_ms`, `rerank.errors`. Alert when p95 > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

deploy-bot: PR #842 merged into feature/chatflow-decision-matrix — smoke tests queued.

maria (PM): Thanks all. Please :+1: if you agree with the default scoping and rollout. If you have unresolved blockers (cost, infra, legal), call them out here. I'll finalize scope Fri 5pm PT.
